name: io.github.bytedance/mcp-server-search
description: MCP server for web and X post search operations

package_arguments.name: provider
package_arguments.description: Search provider (browser_search, bing, tavily, searxng, duckduckgo, or xquik)

package_arguments.name: engine
package_arguments.description: Search engine to use for browser search (default: google)

package_arguments.name: api-key
package_arguments.description: API key for the search provider

package_arguments.name: base-url
package_arguments.description: Base URL for the search provider

environment_variables.name: X_TWITTER_SCRAPER_API_KEY
environment_variables.description: Xquik API key when provider is xquik

environment_variables.name: X_TWITTER_SCRAPER_BASE_URL
environment_variables.description: Optional Xquik API base URL override
